steps.title: Client consultation and safe setup
steps.demonstration: Ask desired length, assess hair, drape and sanitize tools; demonstrate clean blades and setup.

steps.title: Blades and clipper guards
steps.demonstration: Show guarded and unguarded clipper blades, guard sizes, attachment and safe blade checks on camera; explain what each changes.

steps.title: Grip, angles, direction, pressure
steps.demonstration: Close-up of hand holding the clipper, blade-to-hair relationship, cutting direction, controlled pressure and safe motion.

steps.title: Cut hair in a continuous pass
steps.demonstration: Show the barber making a sustained, uninterrupted actual cutting pass from start to result, narrating the visible motion.

steps.title: Guard progression and blending
steps.demonstration: Demonstrate successive guards, lever adjustments when relevant, and actual visible blending on the same haircut.

steps.title: Clipper-over-comb and scissor-over-comb
steps.demonstration: Close-up of hand, comb, blades/scissors; visibly remove hair while describing coordination and safety.

steps.title: Outline and refine
steps.demonstration: Demonstrate safe edging and detail work, then show symmetry and balance checks.

steps.title: Sanitize and evaluate result
steps.demonstration: Show finished haircut, cleanup, blade care and disinfection following product directions.

questions.question: Before using a clipper guard, what should the barber verify?
options: That it is firmly seated and the blade is clean and safe
That the clipper is at maximum speed
That the client’s hair is wet in every case
That the blade is pressed flat against bare skin
questions.explanation: A secure guard and properly maintained blade reduce unintended cutting and safety risks.

questions.question: Why begin with a longer guard when the requested length is uncertain?
options: It always makes a closer fade
It reduces the risk of removing too much hair
It replaces client consultation
It eliminates the need to blend
questions.explanation: Starting conservatively allows length to be reduced intentionally.

questions.question: What must students see during the main demonstration?
options: Only a barber shop montage
A close-up of a clipper box
A sustained cutting pass showing hand placement, clipper motion and hair being removed
Only text explaining blade sizes
questions.explanation: The core skill must be visibly demonstrated rather than narrated over unrelated footage.

questions.question: What is the purpose of clipper-over-comb?
options: To disinfect scissors
To control hair length and blending using the comb as a guide
To avoid using guards on every haircut
To replace client instructions
questions.explanation: The comb presents and controls hair to be trimmed, supporting controlled blending.

questions.question: What should happen after finishing the cut?
options: Immediately reuse tools
Skip checking symmetry
Check the result with the client and clean/disinfect tools according to product instructions
Turn off the camera before evaluating the cut
questions.explanation: Quality checks and infection-control procedures complete the service.
